title: BG graph is missing in small widget
body:
With the latest xdrip+ ("xDrip-plus-20201218-056b822.apk") I´ve got a problem.
In my xdrip+ widget:
- the white dots and 
- the two lines (for high and low glucose level) dissapeared.

Please look at the picture.
![android](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59091948/102686508-74a32880-41e8-11eb-9124-32961518bfe5.jpg)

comments.body:
Just for information - this seems to be an undesired effect of this change in the 2020-12-18 nightly build:
"**Merge pull request #1024 from k2s/widget:
_widget improvements_**"
@k2s Please can you have a look?

It is strange but after installing the "Nightly build 13th Jan 2021" I run into the same problem but for all widget sizes. I've updated all nightly builds in between but never had this problem until today. If I go step-wise back, the graph appears only after installing "Nightly build 16th Dec 2020". Will look into, tomorrow.
This should be resolved in recent nightlies, please confirm thanks
Graph is effectively back since 2101151518 for small width widgets (2x1,3x1), whereas it was only visible for 4x1 till that build.
